description: Sri Lanka Customs - Notify the rates of exchange effective from 06.08.2018 to 12.08.2018
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and contains regulatory content about the determination of official exchange rates for customs duties and charges. It rescinds a previous notification and establishes new legally-binding rates, making it a regulatory matter that falls under Legal/Regulatory classification.
